matches.notes: This is the opening match of the episode; the studio intro runs from the presenter's welcome to the day's fixtures (00:53) into the commentary handover. The manager/player interviews at 11:04-12:06 are pitchside and treated as part of the highlights package; studio analysis begins at 12:06 and ends as the presenter turns to Newcastle v Bournemouth at 16:00.

The studio intro is a single continuous link from the presenter that begins mid-line at 16:00 ("OK, well, it was four points from two games for Newcastle...") immediately after the Fulham v Palace analysis, and ends with the commentator credit. Highlights include the post-match manager/player interviews from 22:55. Studio analysis runs on into the light-hearted 'Murphy on Murphy' clip before the presenter turns to Man City v Coventry at 27:20.

matches.handover: Steve Bower was at the Etihad.
Chris Wise was at the Gtech Community Stadium.
Guy Mowbray was at the City Ground.

matches.notes: The subtitle line beginning at 76:53 runs a post-match answer ("Maybe an expectation to fight for a Champions League place... collect the points") straight into the studio's promoted-teams stat ("...that is why it's been a remarkable start and look at that, these are promoted teams...") without a speaker change, so the highlights/studio boundary falls mid-line at roughly 77:14.
matches.handover: Conor McNamara was at the MKM Stadium.

matches.notes: This match was played the previous evening (Friday) and is shown last in the episode as "last night's action". The post-match interviews with both managers run to 85:57 — the host's question at 85:26 about Isak is put to Liverpool's manager, not to the studio pundits, so it is counted within the highlights package; studio analysis proper begins with the Joe Hart question at 85:57 and ends when the host moves on to the league table at 87:49.
matches.handover: James Fielden was at Portman Road.
